summary: Iteration 35 — Referral system end-to-end testing. Backend pytest: 15/15 passed (test_iter35_referrals.py). Frontend Playwright: all critical flows pass — register banner with ?ref=GRY9J9 shows 'Te invita María · María's Cleaning Services' + gift icon; invalid ref code hides banner; ProviderDashboard ReferralPanel renders all 11 expected testids (panel, title, share-url, copy/share/qr buttons, 3 stats, invite email/note/submit); active-bonus banner shows '29 días restantes' confirming /api/me/referral-credit integration; QR modal opens with QRCodeSVG. Regression iter32/33/34 all pass (after a 60s sleep to dodge auth rate-limit). Dev-fallback email log confirmed with subject '💸 María te invitó a getamano — primer mes Pro gratis'.

minor.issue: Rate limit (5/60s) makes back-to-back regression suites fail at setup — not an iter35 regression; tests recover after a sleep. Consider exempting test fixtures or raising limit for known test accounts.

action_items: (Optional) Add data-testid='share-ecard-block' to ShareECardBlock root for stable selector — currently found only by class. Non-blocking.
(Optional) Add a test-account allowlist on the /api/auth/login rate-limiter so CI test suites don't trip 429.
critical_code_review_comments: _grant_referral_reward correctly idempotent (status='credited' guard + notification_key uniqueness). Re-approval verified to not double-credit.

Self-referral guard inside _track_referral_signup (`referrer.user_id == referred_user_id`) is correct but never reachable in practice because a provider has their ref_code only after their profile exists — i.e. they're already registered. The guard remains a good safety net.
/api/referral/preview returns 200 {valid:false} for unknown codes — correctly avoids enumeration leak per requirement (NOT 404).
Invite endpoint stores tracking row even when send fails (no_api_key) — good for analytics; the 24h dedupe is keyed on (referrer_user_id, invited_email).

ReferralPanel.jsx (frontend) properly mounts QRCodeSVG and active-bonus banner pulls /api/me/referral-credit — integration verified live (María shows 29 days remaining from the test invitee approval that fired during pytest run).

Also a few referral_invites rows for iter35_invite_*@example.com and iter35_dup_*@example.com. These can be cleaned via Mongo (find by email prefix 'test_iter35_invitee_' or 'iter35_'). The demo.provider's pro_referral_until is now set to ~30 days out as a side-effect of the reward test — this is also visible in the dashboard active-bonus banner.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Demo provider María's pro_referral_until was set during iter35 test run — her dashboard will show the green 'active bonus' banner until that date expires (~30 days). If you need a clean María, clear users.pro_referral_until for demo.provider@getamano.com. The /api/auth/login rate limit (5/60s) bites when running multiple module-scoped pytest files back-to-back — interleave a sleep or run files separately. ReferralPanel relies on QRCodeSVG from qrcode.react v4 — it's already in package.json.
rca_of_the_issue: N/A — no bugs found. All 15 backend tests + frontend flows passed first attempt.
